transcript.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for offering to help with the plant-sitting. Let me lay out what we're working with: We have three plants — a jade plant, an orchid, and a Boston fern — and their owner will be away from July 1 through July 14. The jade plant needs strong direct light, the orchid needs bright indirect light and humidity, and the Boston fern does best in shade and steady moisture. I have a sunny south-facing sunroom, and both Marco and Talia have offered to keep plants at their homes. Also, the owner's care card specifies the orchid should be watered on July 2, July 6, July 10, and July 14. Before I make final assignments, I'd love to hear from Marco and Talia about the lighting conditions at your homes — that will help me figure out the best placement for each plant.
